component.name: CloudPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.baseUrl = "http://10.0.0.159:8080" m.scrollOffset = 0 m.items = [] buildChrome() m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "ApiTask") m.task.observeField("result", "onResult") end sub
sub buildChrome() bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 0] bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 596 bg.color = "0x0D1117FF"
titleBar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") titleBar.translation = [36, 12] titleBar.width = 1208 titleBar.height = 40 titleBar.color = "0x161B22FF"
titleLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") titleLbl.translation = [52, 18] titleLbl.text = " CLOUD ACCOUNTS" titleLbl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" titleLbl.color = "0xE6EDF3FF"
m.statusLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.statusLbl.translation = [900, 22] m.statusLbl.text = "Loading..." m.statusLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.statusLbl.color = "0x8B949EFF"
' headers hdrBg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") hdrBg.translation = [36, 60] hdrBg.width = 1208 hdrBg.height = 28 hdrBg.color = "0x21262DFF"
cols = [["ACCOUNT", 52], ["PROVIDER", 440], ["REGION", 620], ["STATUS", 800], ["RESOURCES", 1020]] for each col in cols h = m.top.createChild("Label") h.translation = [col[1], 64] h.text = col[0] h.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" h.color = "0x58A6FFFF" end for
m.rowGroup = m.top.createChild("Group") m.rowGroup.translation = [0, 92] end sub
function load(args as Dynamic) m.statusLbl.text = "* Fetching..." m.task.url = m.baseUrl + "/api/cloud/accounts" end function
sub onResult() data = m.task.result if data = invalid m.statusLbl.text = "No response" return end if if data.doesExist("error") m.statusLbl.text = "X " + data.error return end if
items = invalid if type(data) = "roArray" then items = data keys = ["accounts", "data", "cloud_accounts", "results"] for each k in keys if items = invalid and data.doesExist(k) and type(data[k]) = "roArray" items = data[k] end if end for if items = invalid then items = []
m.items = items m.scrollOffset = 0 renderRows()
dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() m.statusLbl.text = "Updated " + str(dt.GetHours()).trim() + ":" + rp(dt.GetMinutes()) end sub
sub renderRows() while m.rowGroup.getChildCount() > 0 m.rowGroup.removeChildIndex(0) end while
maxRows = 12 rowH = 38 y = 0 endIdx = m.scrollOffset + maxRows - 1 if endIdx >= m.items.count() then endIdx = m.items.count() - 1
for i = m.scrollOffset to endIdx item = m.items[i]
odd = m.rowGroup.createChild("Rectangle") odd.translation = [36, y] odd.width = 1208 odd.height = rowH - 1 if i mod 2 = 0 then odd.color = "0x0D1117FF" else odd.color = "0x161B22FF"
name = safeStr(item, "name", safeStr(item, "account_name", safeStr(item, "id", "account-" + str(i).trim()))) provider = safeStr(item, "provider", safeStr(item, "cloud", safeStr(item, "type", "-"))) region = safeStr(item, "region", safeStr(item, "location", "-")) status = safeStr(item, "status", safeStr(item, "health", "unknown")) resources = safeStr(item, "resource_count", safeStr(item, "resources", "-"))
m_makeLbl(m.rowGroup, 52, y + 9, name, "0xE6EDF3FF", 380) m_makeLbl(m.rowGroup, 440, y + 9, UCase(provider), "0x58A6FFFF", 172) m_makeLbl(m.rowGroup, 620, y + 9, region, "0x8B949EFF", 172) m_makeLbl(m.rowGroup, 800, y + 9, UCase(status), statusColor(status), 212) m_makeLbl(m.rowGroup, 1020, y + 9, resources, "0x8B949EFF", 200)
y = y + rowH end for
if m.items.count() > maxRows hint = m.rowGroup.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [36, y + 4] hint.text = "^ v scroll (" + str(m.items.count()).trim() + " total)" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = "0x8B949EFF" end if
if m.items.count() = 0 empty = m.rowGroup.createChild("Label") empty.translation = [52, 20] empty.text = "No cloud accounts configured." empty.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" empty.color = "0x8B949EFF" end if end sub
sub m_makeLbl(grp as Object, x as Integer, y as Integer, text as String, color as String, w = 300 as Integer) lbl = grp.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [x, y] lbl.text = text lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lbl.color = color lbl.width = w lbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..." end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "down" and m.scrollOffset + 12 < m.items.count() m.scrollOffset = m.scrollOffset + 1 renderRows() return true else if key = "up" and m.scrollOffset > 0 m.scrollOffset = m.scrollOffset - 1 renderRows() return true end if return false end function
